name: xKey
author: Crystal CM
description: Time a click on the edge of the block right before the pink orb at 47% to land on the pillar and then time a click very shortly after landing to fall up between the spike and reverse gravity portal as the ball at 48%. Don’t click until 53.0% when you have to click when your icon reaches the start of the pink pad, (the pad won't affect your icon) buffer a click after doing so for when your icon lands on the block and then don’t click to fall to the floor. Stay on the floor until the end from there.
